newsitem.title: SPAIN: Peseta slips vs mark in line with peripherals.
newsitem.headline: Peseta slips vs mark in line with peripherals.

text.p: The peseta weakened against the mark in afternoon trade on Wednesday, in line with other peripheral European currencies, dealers said.
At 1435 GMT the peseta was quoted at 83.76/78 to the mark, compared with 83.47/50 early this morning.
"On all the mark crosses we've seen a bit of squeezing out on the top side," said one London trader.
He said the peseta should remain steady at around 83.75 to the mark for the moment, adding that a wider fluctuation range could be pegged between 83.65 and 83.95.
The strength of the dollar had not helped the Spanish currency to gain ground, as is usually the case.
"Despite dollar/mark strength, we think that in some way the peseta needs a rest after its recent strong rise," said a second trader.
